steps.title: What is a back-rank mate?
steps.body: The king is trapped on its first rank by its own pawns. A rook or queen then gives check along that rank, and the king cannot escape.

steps.title: The trap
steps.body: Rook to a8 is checkmate. The pawns on f7, g7, and h7 block every escape square.

steps.title: Find the mate
steps.body: Deliver the mate with the rook.
steps.hint: Find the rook move onto the eighth rank.
steps.success: Checkmate! The pawns trapped their own king.
